AnimationFixer.Title: Animation fixer
AnimationFixer.Description:
Select parameters that you want to fix.
Hover on a checkbox for more information
AnimationFixer.EndFrameTooltip: Clamp end frame value to animation's frame count.
AnimationFixer.NextAnimationTooltip:
Clamp next animation number to actual animation count.
This may break transitions to animations in other slots, like vehicle extra.
AnimationFixer.NextFrameTooltip:
Clamp next frame to next animation's end frame.
This may help in cases when end frame was manually edited for next animation.
AnimationFixer.StateChangeRangesTooltip:
Clamps low and high frame bounds for all state changes to animation's end frame
and solves the cases when low frame is greater than high frame.
AnimationFixer.StateChangeNextAnimationTooltip:
Clamp next animation number to actual animation count for all state changes.
This may break transitions to animations in other slots, like vehicle extra.
AnimationFixer.StateChangeNextFrameTooltip:
Clamp next frame to next animation's end frame for all state changes.
This may help in cases when end frame was manually edited for next animation.
AnimationFixer.RestoreAnimationNameTooltip:
If object was imported from legacy wad with incorrect game version,
this feature will restore animation name according to current destination wad2 version.
AnimationFixer.LegacyEngineWarningMessage:
Make sure you know what you are doing.
This action may break compatibility with legacy engines!
